required_phrases: Do not treat roadmap items below as shipped features

required_gates.title: Protocol v1 contract and CI gates
Android tests and debug APK clean build
macOS release build and full-Xcode unit tests
macOS Host hardware compatibility matrix
blockers: The published current-base macos-hardware-compatibility-gate summaries for Mac16,8 readiness are blocked, not passing.
Stable signing/TCC proof, source-bound installed Host provenance, full macOS checks, packaged runtime launch, Protocol v1 stream, input smoke, and reconnect evidence are missing for that row.
Intel Macs, additional Apple silicon models, macOS builds, and display topologies still require exact-row passing evidence before support claims.

required_gates.title: Android USB stream, reconnect, stale epoch, and codec fallback
Telemetry and external latency artifact archive
blockers: The latest current-base latency preflight remains blocked readiness; no external-camera latency sample package or synchronized-clock physical-input proof exists for the Phase 0 evidence archive.

required_gates.title: Host RSS two-hour no-growth gate
blockers: The retained two-hour Xiaomi 13 stream was stable but Host RSS grew about 18.3 MB with a positive second-half slope.

The latest current-base readiness records are blocked before a stable-signed, TCC-ready, listener-observed current-source Host can be launched with native VIBE_SCREEN_TELEMETRY_PATH coverage and a USB/LAN stream window.

required_gates.title: Native pointer HID mouse move/click acceptance
blockers: No physical Android mouse, touchpad, or trackball was attached during a Protocol v1 run.

The latest current-base native-pointer HID summaries remain blocked and do not retain Android forwarding logs, Host pointer-injection logs, and visible Mac move/click result from the same observation window.

required_gates.title: Controller runtime acceptance
blockers: No physical Android controller runtime run is recorded.
No identity-signed Host with approved virtual HID entitlement, Host availability, Mac-side response, and neutral release on disconnect is recorded in one pass evidence bundle.

required_gates.title: Android/macOS clipboard product E2E
blockers: Host readiness is blocked on stable signing, installed Host source provenance, read-only TCC verification, Host listener availability, virtual HID entitlement, and login/headless readiness.

No retained bidirectional Android ClipboardManager -> macOS NSPasteboard and macOS NSPasteboard -> Android ClipboardManager product transfer evidence exists with exact system clipboard endpoints, explicit user action, Protocol v1 session ownership, verified session epoch, verified origin device ID, 16-byte change ID, SHA-256 digest, bounded byte length, final digest match, distinct markers, and final marker equality.
Existing P0110 evidence proves only local Android ClipboardManager smoke and offline/protocol readiness; it must not be relabeled as Xiaomi 13/fuxi evidence.

required_gates.title: Android/macOS file-transfer product E2E
blockers: Host readiness is blocked on stable signing, source provenance, read-only TCC verification, virtual HID entitlement, and login/headless readiness.

No retained bidirectional Android -> macOS and macOS -> Android product transfer evidence exists with file offer/request/content packets, explicit sender action, receiver approval, remote write, final SHA-256 equality, positive session epoch, and cancel cleanup.

required_gates.title: Phase 0 module ownership extraction
blockers: Android TCP transport ownership is enforced, and StreamClient now delegates local session, input, protocol-action, media-routing, and Protocol v1 file-transfer/WakeHost side-effect owner checks, but it still composes transport with local product-session behavior.
Broader protocol/session, decoder, renderer, and UI ownership are not yet all enforced by current-base module contracts.

deferred_or_later_phase_gates.reason: Phase 0 PRD allows LAN to remain a buildable loopback path; README keeps current-worktree LAN evidence as an open Phase 1/local Android gate. The latest current-main unblock readiness record remains outside this Phase 0 stable-release prerequisite set.
Documented as macOS/Phase 2 integration evidence, not a Phase 0 stable-release aggregate prerequisite in this manifest.
Current package evidence is ad-hoc signed only; this blocks distribution claims but is tracked outside the Phase 0 source-baseline aggregate.
